activity.notes: Representative span covering Zhang Qian's major Han diplomatic missions to Central Asia, conventionally beginning with the mission sent in 138 BCE and extending through the later mission around 119–115 BCE.

sources.title: Silk Roads: the Routes Network of Chang'an-Tianshan Corridor — UNESCO World Heritage Centre
sources.citation_text: UNESCO describes Zhang Qian's mission to the Western Regions as a milestone event in the development of the Silk Roads and the expansion of Han contacts with Central Asia.
